name: Death Spawn
body:
You are very resilient versus negative energy.

Prerequisite: Obitu.

Benefit: Increase your racial negative energy resistance value by 5. In addition, you gain a +4 bonus on saves against all death spells and magical death effects. You are granted a save to negate such effects even if one is not normally allowed.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
